from numpy import array


def remplir_f1():
    f1 = open("chaine.txt", "w")
    fin = False
    while not fin:
        ch = input("ch= ")
        f1.write(ch)
        rep = input("autre rep = ")
        while not (rep in ["O", "N"]):
            rep = input("autre rep = ")
        fin = (rep == "N")
    f1.close()


def remplir_t(t):
    f1 = open("chaine.txt", "r")
    ch = f1.readline()
    while ch != "":
        for i in range(len(ch)):
            if "A" <= ch[i].upper() <= "Z":
                t[ord(ch[i].upper()) - 65] += 1
        ch = f1.readline()
    f1.close()


def remplir_f2(t):
    f2 = open("frequence.txt", "w")
    for i in range(26):
        ch = "la frequence de " + chr(i + 65) + "=" + str(t[i]) + "\n"
        f2.write(ch)
    f2.close()


def affichage():
    f2 = open("frequence.txt", "r")
    """
    # methode num 1 lecture ligne par ligne
    ch = f2.readline()
    while ch != "":
        print(ch)
        ch = f2.readline()

    f2.close()
"""


    #2eme methode
    ch=f2.read()
    print(ch)

t = array([int()] * 26)
remplir_f1()
remplir_t(t)
remplir_f2(t)
affichage()
